title: Priority Pulse: 45-day sprint communique (draft)
content:
Status: Working draft for leadership review. Purpose: create a tight 45-day alignment sprint that delivers finalized company-level OKRs, a polished exec update narrative, and an All-Hands runbook that scales to a 600-person company meeting. This doc captures owners, timeline, asks, risks, and rehearsal cadence.

Top-level goals for the 45-day sprint
- Finalize company OKRs for the next quarter (goal clarity + measurable success criteria).
- Produce an executive update deck and two-minute CEO talking points.
- Prepare All-Hands runbook (run-of-show, Q&A plan, escalation tree).
- Identify cross-team blockers and commit owners for mitigation.

Timeline (high-level)
- Week 0 (Feb 10–16): Draft OKRs circulated to exec + partners. Collect feedback.
- Week 1 (Feb 17–23): OKR iteration + metric owners assigned. First draft exec deck.
- Week 2 (Feb 24–Mar 2): Cross-functional alignment (Product / Eng / GTM / Ops). Resolve major conflicts.
- Week 3 (Mar 3–9): Exec rehearsals, finalize slides, finalize communication plan.
- Week 4 (Mar 10–16): All-Hands dry run, finalize Q&A triage, pre-reads distributed.
- Week 5 (Mar 17–23): Final approvals, asset uploads, reminder comms. All-Hands. Post-mortem within 72 hours.

Primary owners (tentative)
- Sprint lead: Maya Patel (company-ops)
- OKR shepherd: Liam O'Connor (product-ops)
- Exec deck & narrative: Janelle Kim (CEO office / comms)
- All-Hands logistics: Diego Ramos (people ops)
- Metrics validation: Priya Singh (finance)
content_continued:
Draft company-level OKR candidates (for exec review)
- Objective A: Make inference economics predictable for our customers
  - KR1: Reduce median 95th-percentile response latency for hosted API by 20% on production workloads (measured on top 10 customer routes).
  - KR2: Lower average per-token cost for typical generation workloads by 15% via batching + cache improvements.
  - KR3: Publish and onboard two new quantization profiles for popular models with verified perf/quality tradeoffs.

- Objective B: Expand enterprise adoption and reliability for Dedicated & Private
  - KR1: Close 3 Dedicated contracts with >$200k ARR commits.
  - KR2: Achieve 99.95% SLA for Dedicated clusters in two regions.
  - KR3: Deliver Private VPC deployment playbook and pass SOC-like checklist for one pilot customer.

- Objective C: Developer experience that drives PLG motion
  - KR1: Improve time-to-first-successful-call for new signups from 30m -> 10m (measured via onboarding funnel).
  - KR2: Ship SDK revamp with two major language bindings and example apps.
  - KR3: Reduce docs-to-support ratio: lower top-10 onboarding support ticket volume by 30%.

Notes on OKRs
- These are purposely high-level. Need metric owners to add definitions and sources (dashboard queries, event properties).
- Open question: do we fold a reliability-focused objective into Objective B or create a separate reliability OKR? Exec input needed.

Exec update narrative (outline of slides / talking points)
1) One-slide company health snapshot (revenue, MRR cadence, usage growth, key wins) — owner: Priya
2) What we shipped last quarter (3–5 bullets, customer stories) — owner: Product leads
3) The problem we solve (brief framing: inference economics + reliability) — owner: CEO
4) The 45-day commitments (what we will deliver & why it matters) — owner: Maya + Liam
5) Risks and mitigation (capacity, hiring, regulatory) — owner: SRE/Legal reps
6) Ask of the company (how to help, where to focus) — owner: CEO / Head of GTM

All-Hands runbook (working)
- Target length: 55 minutes total
  - 0–5m: Welcome + mission anchor (CEO)
  - 5–12m: Product highlight + customer story (PM)
  - 12–20m: Engineering: performance wins & roadmap (Eng lead)
  - 20–30m: Business & go-to-market update (GTM lead)
  - 30–40m: People & hiring update (People Ops)
  - 40–50m: 5 rapid-fire team demos (30s each)
  - 50–55m: Live Q&A + closing (CEO)

Q&A plan + triage
- Pre-collect questions via Form link in pre-read. Tag as product, infra, hiring, billing.
- Live questions triaged by a panel (Janelle + Diego + Engineering SRE lead).
- Escalation: technical deep dives redirected to hour-long office hours by topic.

Rehearsal & assets
- Slide deck deadline: Mar 9 COB (owner: Janelle).
- Exec rehearsal window: Mar 10–12 (book 45m slots).
- AV test + hybrid room check: Mar 15 (Diego to confirm room and stream).

Open decisions / friction points (explicit asks for execs)
- Decision: single company OKR set vs. prioritized thematic buckets (deadline: Feb 21) — owner: CEO + Maya
- Decision: SLA commitment level for Dedicated (99.9 vs 99.95) — owner: Head of SRE + Sales lead
- Ask: Headcount tradeoffs — need final hiring slate for Q2 by Feb 28 (owner: People Ops + Eng managers)

Known risks
- Capacity constraints: GPU procurement timelines still slipping for Dedicated nodes; affects SLA promise.
- Metric hygiene: dashboards not yet instrumented for all KR definitions.
- Cross-functional alignment: GTM needs clearer success stories for contract signings.

Quick checklist (near-term)
- [ ] Exec review meeting scheduled (Feb 19) — Maya
- [ ] OKR metric owners assigned in doc (Feb 23) — Liam
- [ ] First-pass exec deck v0 shared (Feb 24) — Janelle
- [ ] All-Hands venue & stream confirmed (Mar 15) — Diego
- [ ] Pre-read draft to employees (Mar 12) — Janelle

Notes to self / rough fragments
- Might be useful to pin a short "what success looks like" blurb to each KR to avoid ambiguous measures (e.g., "Reduce median 95th-latency on top-10 routes" needs list of routes).
- Slack thread: #company-allhands-prep — use threads for slides comments only.
- Consider a 10-min safety net in run-of-show for incident updates if needed.

References & artifacts
- Confluence: Quarter 2025 planning page (link above).
- Jira: JIRA-ENG-5412 (OKR instrumentation work), JIRA-SALES-2211 (Dedicated contract funnel).
- Internal dashboard: /dash/perf/latency-top10

Immediate asks for exec reviewers
- Please add comments inline on Confluence by Feb 18 (specifically on objectives and the KR quant definitions).
- If you want a separate OKR for Reliability, flag it in Slack with a one-paragraph rationale.
- Approve rehearsal time slots (Doodle link in Slack thread).

Next steps
- Consolidate feedback after Feb 19 exec review, lock owners, and publish a trimmed OKR sheet for org-level planning.
- Schedule a 30-min cross-functional alignment workshop for Feb 25 to resolve conflicts.

-- End draft --

Unresolved: Need clarity on whether Demo segment is curated or open sign-ups (impacts rehearsal load). Also need confirmation on whether remote-only attendees get the same Q&A channel (Diego to confirm).
